# Beseam: expanded public summary

Beseam makes AI a revenue channel for webshops. It is the easiest way to get a webshop's products recommended by AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Google AI Mode, Perplexity and Copilot. Merchants optimise product descriptions, content and technical performance in minutes, and see what AI visibility earns them in traffic and revenue.

## Who it is for

Webshops with hundreds or thousands of products, currently on Shopify. Beseam is built for product catalogues rather than blogs or brand pages: it works product by product, across every variant.

## What Beseam does

1. AI visibility tracking: Beseam builds the questions shoppers ask from the store's own catalogue, asks them across AI assistants on a regular schedule, and records which products are recommended and which competitors appear instead. Visibility is linked to AI-referred traffic and revenue by topic, question, product and landing page.
2. Product descriptions: Beseam finds missing facts and product data (use case, fit, materials, sizes, specifications) and suggests optimised descriptions that AI can match to shopper questions.
3. Content creation: Beseam finds shopper questions without a good page on the store and drafts collection pages, comparisons, blog posts and buying guides built around the merchant's own products.
4. Technical performance: Beseam checks structured data, crawler access for AI crawlers, sitemaps and page speed, and re-checks after each fix.

## How it works

1. Connect a Shopify webshop in one click, without touching theme code.
2. Get improvements ranked by expected revenue impact.
3. Approve changes in a few clicks, or automate the types of change the merchant trusts. Every customer-facing change waits for approval unless automated, and all changes stay reversible.
4. Track how AI visibility, traffic and revenue change over time.

## What Beseam is not

- It is not a promise of guaranteed recommendations, rankings, traffic or revenue.
- It does not publish customer-facing changes without the merchant's approval, unless the merchant chose to automate that type of change.
- It does not claim to know an AI assistant's hidden ranking logic. AI answers are point-in-time observations and can change.

## Company

Beseam was founded by Pankaj Kumar, a former Google and Amazon engineer who worked on measurement, reliability and large-scale data systems. Beseam is built in Zurich, Switzerland, and is advised by ecommerce operators and founders.
